story_description: As a user installing CLIs during onboarding, I need a robust state machine that tracks scanning, detection, installation progress, completion, skip, and error states so that the UI can accurately reflect what is happening and recover gracefully from failures
task_description: Create CLISetupState enum with all installation states (scanning, detected, installing, complete, skipped, error) and InstallProgress struct for tracking individual CLI installation progress
atom: A001: CLISetupState Enum and InstallProgress Implementation
atom_description: Define CLISetupState enum with six cases (scanning, detected, installing, complete, skipped, error) each carrying appropriate associated values, plus InstallProgress struct with downloadProgress, verifyProgress, installProgress, and currentStep properties
problem_statement: The CLI installation flow requires a deterministic state machine to coordinate UI updates, prevent invalid transitions, enable pause/resume/cancel, and provide clear error recovery paths. Without explicit state modeling, the UI would need to infer state from multiple boolean flags leading to impossible state bugs.
scope_in: CLISetupState enum with six cases: scanning, detected, installing, complete, skipped, error
Associated values for detected (results array), installing (cli, progress, queue), complete (installed, failed), error (SetupError)
InstallProgress struct with downloadProgress (Double 0-1), verifyProgress (Double 0-1), installProgress (Double 0-1), currentStep (String)
Equatable and Hashable conformance for SwiftUI observation
Debug description for logging state transitions
scope_out: Actual installation logic (handled by CLIInstaller in separate atom)
UI rendering of states (handled by CLISetupView)
Persistence of state (in-memory only, restart resets to scanning)
assumptions: CLIType enum already exists from C001-MODELS atom
CLIDetectionResult struct already exists from C001-MODELS atom
SetupError enum will be defined in this same file for colocation
State transitions are synchronous and deterministic
Only one CLI can be installing at a time (sequential not parallel)
constraints: Must be Sendable for async/await usage across actor boundaries
State enum must be exhaustive (no default cases in switches)
Progress values must be clamped to 0.0-1.0 range
Complete state must preserve both success and failure lists for summary screen
Error cases must carry enough context for user-actionable error messages
functional_requirements: FR1: CLISetupState.scanning represents initial state during PATH and filesystem checks
FR2: CLISetupState.detected(results:) carries array of CLIDetectionResult for each checked CLI
FR3: CLISetupState.installing(cli:progress:queue:) tracks current CLI being installed, its progress, and remaining queue
FR4: CLISetupState.complete(installed:failed:) provides lists for summary screen showing what succeeded and what failed with reasons
FR5: CLISetupState.skipped represents user choosing to skip CLI installation entirely
FR6: CLISetupState.error(SetupError) captures fatal errors that abort the entire setup flow
FR7: InstallProgress.downloadProgress tracks download completion from 0.0 to 1.0
FR8: InstallProgress.verifyProgress tracks signature/checksum verification from 0.0 to 1.0
FR9: InstallProgress.installProgress tracks file copy and PATH setup from 0.0 to 1.0
FR10: InstallProgress.currentStep provides human-readable description of current operation
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: State enum must compile to less than 100 bytes stack size
NFR2: State transitions must complete in under 1ms (no blocking)
NFR3: Debug descriptions must be useful in Console.app logs
NFR4: Sendable conformance required for MainActor UI binding
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create file Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/Services/CLIInstallationState.swift with file header comment

Step 2: Define SetupError enum with cases: networkUnavailable, downloadFailed(url: URL, underlying: Error), verificationFailed(cli: CLIType, reason: String), installationFailed(cli: CLIType, reason: String), permissionDenied(path: String), userCancelled, timeout(operation: String, seconds: Int)
Step 3: Add SetupError conformance to LocalizedError with errorDescription and recoverySuggestion computed properties
Step 4: Define InstallProgress struct with downloadProgress: Double, verifyProgress: Double, installProgress: Double, currentStep: String
Step 5: Add InstallProgress static factory methods: downloading(progress:), verifying(progress:), installing(progress:), idle
Step 6: Add InstallProgress computed property overallProgress returning weighted average (download 40%, verify 20%, install 40%)
Step 7: Define CLISetupState enum with all six cases and associated values
Step 8: Add CLISetupState extension with isTerminal computed property (true for complete, skipped, error)
Step 9: Add CLISetupState extension with canTransitionTo(_ newState: CLISetupState) validation method
Step 10: Add CLISetupState extension with validNextStates computed property returning Set of valid transitions
Step 11: Add CustomDebugStringConvertible conformance for logging
Step 12: Add Equatable conformance via synthesized conformance (all associated values are Equatable)
Step 13: Add Sendable conformance (enum is value type with Sendable associated values)
data_model_changes: New enum SetupError with 7 cases for error categorization
New struct InstallProgress with 4 stored properties and computed overallProgress
New enum CLISetupState with 6 cases modeling installation lifecycle
api_contracts: SetupError.errorDescription: String? - returns user-facing localized error message
SetupError.recoverySuggestion: String? - returns actionable recovery hint
CLISetupState.isTerminal: Bool - returns true if state requires no further transitions
CLISetupState.canTransitionTo(_:) -> Bool - validates state transition legality
CLISetupState.validNextStates: Set<CLISetupState> - returns allowed next states
event_contracts: N/A - state machine is synchronous, events emitted by ViewModel layer
ui_states: N/A - UI states handled by CLISetupView consuming this state machine
ui_copy: N/A - copy defined in UI layer, not state layer
edge_cases: Edge 1: Installing state with empty queue - represents last CLI being installed
Edge 2: Complete state with all failures - user sees summary of what failed
Edge 3: Progress values received outside 0-1 range - clamp to valid range
Edge 4: Transition from error back to scanning - allowed for retry flow
Edge 5: Transition from complete to scanning - allowed for re-run flow
Edge 6: Rapid state transitions faster than UI refresh - state is always consistent
failure_modes: FM1: Invalid state transition attempted - assertion in debug, log warning in release, ignore transition
FM2: Progress value NaN or infinity - treat as 0.0 with warning log
FM3: Empty detected results array - valid state representing no CLIs found

notes: This atom is foundational - the state machine design influences all dependent atoms including CLISetupViewModel and CLISetupView. Keep the state enum simple and push complexity to the ViewModel layer.

na_justifications.event_contracts[0]: State machine is synchronous value type, events are emitted by consuming ViewModel layer not the state itself
na_justifications.ui_states[0]: State machine defines data states, UI visual states are defined in CLISetupView atom
na_justifications.ui_interactions[0]: State machine has no UI, interactions handled by CLISetupViewModel atom
na_justifications.ui_copy[0]: State machine has no user-facing strings, copy defined in UI layer
na_justifications.test_plan.ui[0]: State machine has no UI, UI tests defined in CLISetupView atom
na_justifications.contracts.persistence[0]: State machine is in-memory only, no persistence required for this atom

risks: State machine design may not cover all future installation scenarios
Progress weighting (40/20/40) may not reflect actual time distribution
Sendable conformance may conflict with future mutable associated values
mitigations: Design state machine with extension points for additional cases
Make progress weighting configurable via static properties
Keep associated values immutable (let) to maintain Sendable
risk_register.blast_radius: Low - state machine is pure value type with no side effects. Changes only affect code that directly consumes CLISetupState.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If state machine design proves inadequate, refactor to class-based state pattern with delegate callbacks. Migration path: deprecate enum, introduce CLISetupStateMachine class, update consumers.
